article.title: Microsoft把Copilot多模型執行框架帶到Foundry

article.detail:
Microsoft於10月28日宣布，將Copilot使用的多模型執行框架透過Foundry提供給開發者及企業，用來組建可使用工具的代理。

框架支援MCP、agent skills及插件，負責模型周邊的編排與執行環境。

企業可下載SDK或使用Foundry託管模式，自行提供指令、工具及模型選擇。

評估行銷 AI 代理時，除了模型選擇，亦需比較系統如何執行任務、管理權限及切換模型。

建議先以只讀取市場資料的任務測試，比較接入成本、執行紀錄，以及任務失敗後的恢復方式。

公告未提供適用每個市場的價格或行銷ROI實測；這是開發基建，並非即裝即用的完整行銷代理。
article.detail_en:
Microsoft’s October 28 announcement makes its multi-model Copilot runtime available through Foundry for developers and enterprises building tool-using agents.

It supports MCP, agent skills and plugins, orchestrating the environment around the model.

Teams can download the SDK or use Foundry hosting, supplying instructions, tools and model choices.

Marketing-agent evaluations should cover execution, permissions and model switching as well as model choice.

Compare integration effort, logs and failure recovery on one read-only market-data task.

The release supplies no market-by-market pricing or marketing ROI test; this is infrastructure, not a complete ready-made marketing agent.
